subject: food-technology

items.correct: Yeast ferments sugars, producing carbon dioxide gas.
items.misconception: The heat creates gas from nothing.
items.why: Yeast respires anaerobically, releasing CO₂ that is trapped in the stretchy dough.

items.q: Does boiling vegetables keep all their vitamins?
items.correct: No — water-soluble vitamins (C and B) leach into the water.
items.random_wrong: Steaming destroys more vitamins than boiling.
items.why: Steaming or using less water retains more water-soluble vitamins than boiling.
